comments.content: Holding self._lock across `await asyncio.gather(*tasks)` keeps the vertex lock held for the entire duration of I/O logging. This serializes all vertex work and can cause contention/deadlock. The lock should only guard mutation of `log_transaction_tasks`, not the await.

Clearing `log_transaction_tasks` before awaiting the tasks removes tracking, so `task.add_done_callback(self.log_transaction_tasks.discard)` will never find the tasks. If `gather` raises a non-CancelledError, the new log task is never created and the transaction is silently dropped. Use `return_exceptions=True` or keep the tasks in the set while awaiting.
